basic_info.description: This cheerful property elegantly combines charm and sophistication. Overlooking a tranquil neighborhood street, the bright front door welcomes friends and family into a warm entry foyer with stained glass window featuring the Golden Gate Bridge. The sunny living room is focused around a Victorian-style fireplace, and the adjacent dining room is decorated with a classic box beam ceiling and overlooks the verdant garden. The stylishly redesigned kitchen includes a six-burner gas range, open shelving, wine fridge and seating area, and a chic powder room adjoins the kitchen. Upstairs, the spacious primary bedroom has two large closets and overlooks 29th Avenue, and the cozy second bedroom has a walk-in-closet. The bedrooms share an expansive full bath, complete with soaking tub, top of the line fixtures. The highlight of the lush and landscaped backyard is a secluded office studio. On the garage level there is parking, a storage area, and laundry room. Situated in the Outer Richmond, 377 29th Avenue is nestled in the middle of one of San Francisco's most beloved neighborhoods, just minutes from local haunts and outdoor destinations.
